service.ur: نئے شادی شدہ جوڑوں کے لیے کرایہ امداد

about: Newlywed citizens apply for rental assistance of up to AED 75,000, renewed each year for up to four years.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Newlywed citizens meeting Medeem's terms and conditions
documents: Six months of personal bank statements
For unemployed applicants: letters on registration status with Abu Dhabi pension and with the General Pension and Social Security Authority
Certificate that neither spouse receives an employer rental allowance
timing: Renewed annually, up to four years
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
Provided by Abu Dhabi Housing Authority
